18.
(1) Where the Board considers it necessary for the
purposes of this Act, it may with the approval of the President
in or in relation to a designated area give special or general
directions to any government department or corporation after
consultation with such department or corporation to perform
and  discharge  such  duties  and  functions  relating  to  the
implementation of any development project as the Authority
may determine.
(2) It shall be lawful for any such department or corporation
to whom any such direction is given by the Authority under
subsection (1) to comply with such direction.
(3)  Subject  to  the  provisions  of  the  Constitution,  a
department  or  corporation  to  which  any  direction  is  given
under subsection (1), shall be subject to the supervision and
control of the Authority in respect of all matters connected
with such direction.
